# AFAQ International

> AFAQ International (آفاق الدولية) is an Egyptian trading company based in Alexandria, Egypt, opposite Gate 14 of Alexandria Port. It exports Egyptian agricultural crops, imports fabrics from China for wholesale buyers, and imports industrial equipment.

## Business lines
- Export of Egyptian crops: citrus (oranges, mandarins, Benzahir lemon, Adalia lemon), potatoes, onions, garlic, grapes, pomegranates, strawberries. Availability follows the growing seasons.
- Import of fabrics of all kinds from China to Egypt, for wholesale buyers.
- Industrial equipment: valves, pipes, pumps, electric motors, and PTFE (Teflon) lined valves for the chemical industry.

## How to order
Send the products, quantities and destination port to info@afaq-egypt.com or by WhatsApp. AFAQ replies with an offer. Payment terms, specifications, packing and shipping terms are agreed per order and written in the offer.
